android.desc:
Explain My Phone is a powerful phone analyzer, device information app, smartphone diagnostic tool, app analyzer, security checker, and phone utility that helps you understand your Android device through detailed analysis, hardware information, network diagnostics, system insights, and comprehensive reports.

Analyze installed apps, permissions, Wi-Fi details, sensors, device activity, hardware components, and system behavior in a clear and structured way.

PHONE ANALYZER & DEVICE INSIGHTS

Get a complete overview of your smartphone with detailed device analysis and system information tools.

• Device specifications and hardware details
• Android system information
• Phone configuration analysis
• Device status and diagnostics
• Software and hardware insights
• Technical phone information

INSTALLED APPS ANALYZER

Analyze installed applications and gain visibility into app details.

• View installed applications
• Inspect package information
• Review app permissions
• Check app versions
• Analyze application metadata
• Identify apps using sensitive permissions
• Understand app access levels

APP USAGE & ACTIVITY ANALYSIS

Monitor device activity and application usage patterns.

• Screen time insights
• App usage monitoring
• Frequently used apps
• Usage trend analysis
• Activity statistics
• Device behavior insights

SECURITY & PRIVACY INSIGHTS

Understand permissions and privacy-related app behavior.

• Permission analysis
• Privacy transparency insights
• Sensitive permission review
• Security-focused app information
• App access visibility
• Privacy awareness tools

WI-FI & NETWORK ANALYZER

Access detailed network and connectivity information.

• Wi-Fi details
• SSID information
• IP address details
• DNS information
• Signal strength analysis
• Network status monitoring
• Connectivity diagnostics
• Wireless network insights

DEVICE INFORMATION & DIAGNOSTICS

Explore detailed hardware and system information.

• CPU information
• RAM and memory details
• Storage information
• Battery information
• Android version details
• Device specifications
• Performance insights
• System diagnostics
• Hardware verification
• Device health information

SENSOR & HARDWARE ANALYSIS

Verify available sensors and device components.

• Sensor information
• Sensor availability checks
• Hardware detection
• Component analysis
• Device feature verification
